title: 掼蛋

lines.text: 公司在江苏有一家合作了很多年的工厂，工厂的老板有个爱好：吃完饭一定要打掼蛋。
lines.py: gōng sī zài jiāng sū yǒu yì jiā hé zuò le hěn duō nián de gōng chǎng, gōng chǎng de lǎo bǎn yǒu gè ài hào: chī wán fàn yí dìng yào dǎ guàn dàn.
lines.en: The company has worked for years with a factory in Jiangsu whose owner has one passion: after dinner, there's always a game of guandan.

lines.text: 掼蛋是江苏一带流行的一种扑克游戏，四个人玩，两人一组，坐在对面的就是你的搭档。
lines.py: guàn dàn shì jiāng sū yí dài liú xíng de yì zhǒng pū kè yóu xì, sì gè rén wán, liǎng rén yì zǔ, zuò zài duì miàn de jiù shì nǐ de dā dàng.
lines.en: Guandan is a card game popular around Jiangsu: four players in two teams, and the person sitting opposite you is your partner.
